site: rx_prefilter: the per-iteration `if (forward_state == 0 && last_accept_position == -1)` skip (rx_can_begin_match loop) and the byte-at-a-time step below it
observation: The forward DFA steps EVERY byte: 1.00M steps/MiB on fail, 1.01M syslog, 0.99M hit (counted). The state-0 skip table is \w-complement, but state 0 goes to 29 on a word byte and 29 back to 0 on a non-word byte, so the skip only ever covers runs of 2+ non-word bytes (48k/38k bytes/MiB). {0,29} is one 'searching' component: it is left only by C/E/F read in state 0, and reaches the level-complete state 319 only through a whole ERROR/FATAL/CRIT at a word start. ~20 instr/step, loop-carried state->add->ldrh chain.
proposed_change: In states {0,29} jump straight to the first whole level literal at a word start, found with libc memchr on two rare bytes: 'O' (ERROR+3) and 'T' (FATAL+2, CRIT+3), verified by 2/4-byte compares + the predecessor-is-\W test, cached per stream across the call; none left -> return 0. r1 used three memchr streams on the first bytes C/E/F (3 MiB scanned/MiB, 4.4-7.5k calls/MiB); r2 (sealed) two streams (2 MiB scanned, 2.0k fail / 2.8k syslog / 6.6k hit calls per MiB).
regime: all twelve throughput subjects; sets the cell (median lands in the fail/syslog groups)
correctness_argument: DFA analysis (tools/dfa_dump.py): 0 and 29 step to each other on every byte except C/E/F-in-0; no accept-by-class or end accept in 0/29; prefix excursions (58..377) that do not complete a literal+boundary return to {0,29} without an accept; state at a position p in {0,29} is 0 iff p==0 or s[p-1] is \W (seed rule included); a prefix walk is all word bytes so cannot span a \W predecessor. Window START identical to orig at every search_from on 413 subjects (pfdiff, ASan/UBSan); harness identity PASS plain+san; budget/capacity differential 0 diffs.
expected_effect: fail/syslog: DFA steps 1.0M -> 0 per MiB; residual = 2-2.8k memchr calls over 2 MiB. Est. >=10x on the prefilter (orig ~5-6 cycles/byte latency-bound; memchr streams ~0.1-0.2 cycles/byte). hit: 0.99M -> 20k steps. Scratch timing owed.
generality_guess: Any DFA whose skip loop is keyed on single-state self-loops while a 2+-state component is what actually 'searches' (\b-literal alternations: every \b(?:LIT|...) start). Rare-byte choice is a byte-frequency table decision (measured on these subjects: unmeasured default elsewhere).

observation: Same waste as L1 (1.0M DFA steps/MiB), asked without libc memchr: is the win the component skip itself or memchr's vector speed?
proposed_change: Pure-scalar component skip: in {0,29} run a 256-byte table loop over bytes not in {C,E,F}; at a hit test the predecessor (\W or p==0) -> state 0 and step; else continue. No memchr, no unroll.
correctness_argument: Same component argument as L1 (exits = C/E/F in state 0). Window START identical at every search_from (pfdiff); identity PASS plain+san; budget differential 0 diffs.
expected_effect: fail/syslog: 1.0M DFA steps -> 4.7k/8.9k per MiB; the skip loop is 7 instr/byte with no state chain (asm L11: add/cmp/beq/ldrb/add/ldrb/cbz). Est. ~3x on the prefilter vs orig; well below L1. Scratch timing owed.
generality_guess: Same population as L1; this is the emitter-native form (a bigger skip set, no new kernel). L1 vs L2 isolates memchr's share.

observation: After a level the DFA lives in {406,435} (406 = after \W, 435 = inside a non-keyword word) until \n or a keyword at a word start. The emitted stay loop covers 406's self-loop only (non-word bytes), so every word byte on a level line is a DFA step (hit: ~14k steps/MiB under orig, ~20k of L1's residual).
proposed_change: Skip {406,435} as one component with a 256-byte exit table {\n,d,r,t,u}; at d/r/t/u decide 406 vs 435 from the predecessor; \n or a word-start d/r/t/u -> step normally; end of subject -> return 0.
regime: hit subjects only (level lines); does not move the median
correctness_argument: Rows 406/435: \n -> 0 from both, \W -> 406, other word -> 435, d/r/t/u -> keyword prefixes only from 406; neither accepts (by class or at end). Window identical at every search_from; identity PASS plain+san; control ctlL3 (word-start test dropped) FAILS.
expected_effect: hit: DFA steps on level lines ~14-20k -> ~6k/MiB (L6 residual 5.9k). Small: ~5-15% of post-L1 hit. Scratch timing owed.
generality_guess: Same mechanism as L2 applied to the second component; general to count-collapsed hybrid prefilters with a '.*' middle.

site: rx_prefilter reverse pass (rx_reverse_* tables, stay26 loop) + rx_search_run's VM attempt at the window start
observation: The hybrid re-proves what its DFA already knows twice: (a) the reverse DFA walks back from the accept to the line start (hit: 12.4k reverse steps/MiB) to find a start the forward pass already passed through (the last 319 before the accept); (b) the VM then re-walks level, \b and the lazy .{0,200}? one position at a time with a frame push/pop each (8.1k lazy positions/MiB) to reach the same keyword the forward DFA died on.
proposed_change: r1: record start = (position at a 319 step) - (4 if s[p-1]=='T' else 5); drop the reverse pass. r2: in rx_search_run, when attempt==window start and the window's keyword (matched by suffix) starts <=200 bytes after the level end, report [start,end) without the VM. r3 (sealed): r2 + the fast path also requires room for one trail entry and one frame (trail_depth<trail_cap, resume_depth<resume_cap) and steps_left>256, work_left>2048 (one attempt spends <=201 steps, <=1021 work).
regime: hit subjects (per match); does not move the median
correctness_argument: (a) after-level region entered only via 319->406 and left only via \n/death, so the last 319 before the accept is the line's first level = the reverse pass's leftmost start (window START identical at every search_from, 413 subjects). (b) the lazy step tries keywords left to right; keywords cannot overlap; the DFA dies at the first keyword\b after the level; so the VM's answer is [start,end) whenever the gap fits 200. Budget/capacity differential (step budgets 40..260, work 30..3000, _in with 0/1 frames x 0/1 trail): 0 diffs at r3; r2 had 284k diffs (FRAMES give-ups turned into matches) -- harness identity PASSED r2. Controls ctlL4 (start late) FAIL, ctlL4e (start early) FAIL only by livelock timeout, ctlgap (bound 201) FAIL after exact-gap edge subjects were added.
expected_effect: hit: reverse steps 12.4k -> 0, VM attempts 193 -> 0 per MiB (~200-250k cycles/MiB est.; ~30% of post-L1 hit). Scratch timing owed.
generality_guess: (a) any reverse-pass DFA search whose start is pinned by a forward landmark state; (b) any count-collapsed hybrid whose window can be checked against the count cheaply.

observation: The lazy .{0,200}? pushes a resume frame per position; the keyword tail never pushes, so every frame is popped straight back to rx_L16 with nothing to unwind: ~12 run-> memory ops, an indirect goto and a trail-loop test per position (8.1k positions/MiB on hit). Run counters live in memory (ldr/str [x1,#56/64/72/80]).
proposed_change: Drop the frame: keep the capacity check (resume_depth>=resume_cap -> FRAMES) and the per-position step charge (--steps_left<0 -> STEPS) in the same order; keyword failures `goto rx_L16` directly (10 sites).
regime: hit subjects with VM attempts (and any failing attempt); moot under L4 r3's fast path
correctness_argument: Single choice point; trail mark == trail depth at every pop; same STEPS/FRAMES/WORK points in the same order. Identity PASS plain+san; budget/capacity differential (6 budget pairs x 4 buffer shapes) 0 diffs.
expected_effect: hit: ~45 -> ~25 instr per lazy position, ~75k cycles/MiB est. Scratch timing owed.
generality_guess: Any VM lazy/greedy span whose continuation is frame-free (rvA07a's 'one-path program' family).
